customers.evidence: Our job is to always do right by them and consistently strive not only to meet their needs but also to exceed their expectations

employees.evidence: Provide our employees with the truth, opportunities, training, meaningful work and a commitment to build a healthy, vibrant company

dei.evidence: Excel by embracing an inclusive work environment and diverse teams

community.evidence: Leverage our success in order to give back to the communities where we do business

shareholders.evidence: Work for profitable, sustainable, long-term growth

integrity.evidence: At JPMorgan Chase, acting with integrity is paramount– and it applies to every aspect of our company.

innovation.evidence: drive change and innovation and never stop learning

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice, opening with client service and integrity headlines. Pairs bold commitments with hedges, such as stating it cannot promise specific outcomes. Mostly imperative bullet lists addressing employees and customers, with the Dimon quote framing strength and client loyalty. Distinctive wording includes fortress balance sheet and clerks to CEOs.
